description: This file defines a Java interface 'DeletionConfig' which specifies configuration settings related to the physical deletion of marked 'thing' entities, including methods to determine if deletion is enabled, the age threshold for deletion, deletion interval, and first run hour. It also contains an inner enum 'DeletionConfigValue' for configuration key-value pair defaults.

classes.name: DeletionConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration settings for the physical deletion of 'thing' entities marked as deleted.

classes.name: DeletionConfig.DeletionConfigValue
classes.description: An enum defining configuration keys and their default values for 'DeletionConfig'.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether physical deletion is enabled.

methods.name: getDeletionAge
methods.description: Returns the duration after which deleted 'thing' entities should be physically removed.

methods.name: getRunInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval between physical deletion runs.

methods.name: getFirstIntervalHour
methods.description: Returns the hour (UTC) of the first physical deletion run.
